story: A one-way ride of 335 km, Badamdar to Badamdar - roughly 5 h 47 in the saddle. On the way it passes Gobustan Rock Art Cultural Landscape, Cultural Landscape of Khinalig People and and back through Gobustan Rock Art Cultural Landscape. The highest point is about 1,300 m.
